summary.intent: Land a fix for the weekly recall pairing break caused by #457's aliased-export rename, and investigate a reported empty description for single-line JSDoc in one-line interfaces.
summary.outcome: Draft PR #458 (fix/jsdoc-and-weekly-pairing, trail #351) was opened with an export_alias pairing fix in scripts/weekly.py plus a regression test that fails on base. The JSDoc bug could not be reproduced, so only a fixture was added as coverage, and the item is proposed for closing as not reproducible.

repo: PR #457 renamed aliased exports, so `export { CardRoot as Card }` made Caliper report `Card` while RDT reports `CardRoot`; the weekly recall pairing then failed and would have shown a false recall drop.
scripts/weekly.py pairs Caliper and RDT components, and an `export_alias` pairing is needed to handle aliased exports.
Regression fixtures for semantic extraction live under crates/semantic/tests/fixtures/ (new one: oneline/).
A mid-line `@tag` in a JSDoc stays description text, which is correct TypeScript behaviour and not a bug.
The PR is BLOCKED on Entire Gates after opening; CI and findings have not yet been checked.
`just lint` must run under the project's rustc; the mise shim resolves to rustc 1.98.1 and fails.
`just test-checker-lane` needs network access, which the sandbox blocks.

code.finding: Added an `export_alias` pairing so aliased exports (`export { CardRoot as Card }`) pair correctly after #457; the new test fails on base.

workflow: Verify a subagent's pushed branch head with git ls-remote before publishing.
Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user instructions; publish the worker's PR body unedited and report its claims with their limits.
When a bug cannot be reproduced, ask for the exact failing source rather than widening speculative fixtures.
Checks that fail in the sandbox (wrong toolchain shim, network block) should be left to CI and flagged as such.

friction: The JSDoc empty-description bug could not be reproduced; the original failing source was never available, only a paraphrase from another worker.
`just lint` ran under the wrong rustc (1.98.1 via the mise shim) and failed.
`just test-checker-lane` was blocked by the sandbox network restriction.
PR #458 shows BLOCKED on Entire Gates immediately after opening.
